_comment: Register for scripts/check-asset-category-vocabulary.mjs. The asset category vocabulary has ONE source: v3/asset.json#/properties/category/enum. Every file that mentions a distinctive category value (one containing an underscore) must appear below, either as a copy the gate checks or as a usage with a reason. An unlisted file is refused, so a new copy cannot appear unchecked. Edit this file by hand; it is the classification, not a measurement.

routingSchemas._comment: Schemas whose prose may name a category ('Use when category is ...'). Every name quoted that way must be a member of the source.

consumers._comment: Mixes categories and subcategories by design. Each value must be a category or a subcategory in reference-data/category-guidance.json. The pinned values are neither; they predate this gate. A new one is refused, and a pinned one that has been fixed must be removed from this list (the floor only tightens).

generated._comment: Copies produced from the source by a generator. Each must carry the source list (or the general-branch subset of it) exactly, and exactly the number of copies pinned here: a different count means the generator output changed shape, so the gate cannot answer (exit 2). Regenerate with the command named; never edit by hand.
